## Telegram → Google Drive (backfill)

Walks the **public** web preview `https://t.me/s/<channel>` page by page, so it needs no Telegram credentials — but it only works for public channels. Private ones: use the Python scraper in `telegram-scraper/`.

1. Set `channel`, `max_pages` and `stop_after_id` in **Config**.
2. Add Google Drive and Google Sheets credentials, then pick the destination folder and spreadsheet.
3. Run once. Note the highest `message_id` written and put it in `stop_after_id` for the next run.

Schedule Trigger is disabled by default — enable it for unattended top-ups.
